The background expands to a hazy horizon where the muted blue of the sky meets the sea. The atmosphere is crisp and carries the subtle scent of the sea and industry, with a gentle breeze suggested by light cloud formations. Sunlight glints off the water and metallic surfaces, casting subtle highlights and deep shadows across the scene. The overall mood is one of industrious vitality and grounded history, evoking a sense of exploration and urban charm with pragmatic functionality. The color palette is a sophisticated blend of muted blues and greys in the water and sky, warmed by the browns and reds of brickwork, with accents of yellow, orange, and vibrant greens. This is an urban harbor city captured in bright, diffused daylight, embodying a nautical industrial architectural tone with historic brick and stone elements, reflecting a cultural tone of maritime trade and vibrant urban life.
